The '''Flower Sack''' is an {{Epic}} [[Sacks|Sack]] that holds all types of normal [[Flower|Flowers]], as well as [[End Stone Rose]], [[Enchanted Dandelion]] and [[Enchanted Poppy]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Flower Sack''' can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Elizabeth}} in the [[Community Center]] for {{Bits|14k}}.

== Usage ==
The '''Flower Sack''' can store [[Flowers]].
